title: catalog.product.snapshot — Payload Schema
description: Full catalog snapshot published by erp.catalog. Delivered in batch for initial indexing and periodic reconciliation. Contains three layers: the complete product list, the attribute schema that governs how attributes are structured and indexed, and the publication rules that determined which products are included.

products.description: Complete list of published products at the time of snapshot generation. Products with published: false are excluded by the publication rules unless requires_* rules permit them.

id.description: Stable product identifier from ERP Core. Never reused after deletion.

base_price.description: Pre-tax base price. Tax is calculated by commerce.engine using tax.policy.v1.

published.description: True if the product is visible on the storefront. False products in the snapshot were included for indexing purposes only.

attributes.description: Key-value map of product attributes. Keys must conform to attribute_schema.definitions[].key. Values must conform to the declared data_type and cardinality.

attribute_schema.description: Versioned schema that declares which attribute keys exist, their types, cardinality, and indexing contract with Commerce Engine. Defined by ADR-001 (Accepted with amendments). Amendments 3 (reference type resolution) and 4 (label i18n) remain open and block this contract moving to Stable.

version.description: SemVer version of this attribute schema, independent of the parent contract version. A breaking change in the schema (removing a key, changing data_type, changing cardinality) requires a MAJOR increment here.

definitions.description: Ordered list of attribute definitions. Each entry declares one attribute key and its indexing contract.
definitions.$comment: definitions[].key must be semantically unique across all entries. JSON Schema cannot enforce uniqueness by nested property; key uniqueness is validated in CI.

key.description: Canonical dot-separated attribute identifier. Namespace prefix required. Examples: vehicle.brand, vehicle.year_from, part.side.

data_type.description: Semantic type of the attribute value. Determines indexing strategy. 'reference' is declared but its resolution semantics are pending ADR-001 Amendment 3.

cardinality.description: single: products[].attributes[key] is a scalar. multiple: it is an array. Cross-validation of actual product attribute values against cardinality is enforced in CI, not in this schema.
cardinality.$comment: Cross-validation not enforced at schema level in v1. Closes before Stable.

nullable.description: If true, the attribute may be absent or null in a product's attributes map.

searchable.description: If true, Commerce Engine includes this attribute in full-text search indexing.

filterable.description: If true, Commerce Engine builds an inverted index for filter queries on this attribute.

sortable.description: If true, Commerce Engine maintains a sort index for this attribute.

facetable.description: If true, Commerce Engine exposes this attribute as a storefront facet.

unit.description: Physical or semantic unit. Examples: year, mm, cc, kg. Not restricted to a closed enum in v1.

label.description: Display label for storefront facets and filter UI.
label.$comment: ADR-001 Amendment 4 pending: i18n strategy not decided. Type is temporary. Will be resolved before Stable.

publication_rules.description: Rules applied by ERP Core to determine which products are eligible for this snapshot. These rules are published so consumers understand why some ERP products are absent.

requires_stock.description: If true, products with quantity_available = 0 are excluded.

requires_price.description: If true, products with base_price = 0 are excluded.

requires_image.description: If true, products without thumbnail_url are excluded.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this snapshot was generated by erp.catalog.
